claims.match: Seventy percent of developers now use AI tools
claims.why: Population and wording: the 2023 survey's 70% is respondents 'using or planning to use' AI tools. Only 44% said they were using them.

claims.match: 76% of respondents said they were using or planning to use
claims.why: The 2024 survey: 76% of respondents using or planning to use AI tools, up from 70%. Same survey family as the error above, quoted with its own population and wording. Flagging it is a false alarm.
Gartner (press release, June 25, 2025) predicted that over 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by the end of 2027. A forecast, not a finding, and 'canceled', not 'fail'.
GitHub announced 100 million developers on January 25, 2023.
